name: NVDA vs AMD: Price Action, Relative Performance & Correlation
description: Research study comparing NVDA and AMD across multiple dimensions: indexed cumulative returns (base 100), rolling 60-day return spread with dual-color area fill, rolling 60-day correlation of daily returns, scatter plot of daily returns with regression line, and a summary table with full-period return, annualized volatility, correlation, and beta.
source:
# =============================================================================
# NVDA vs AMD: PRICE ACTION, RELATIVE PERFORMANCE & CORRELATION
# =============================================================================
# Compares NVDA and AMD across:
#   1. Indexed cumulative returns (base 100)
#   2. Rolling 60-day return spread (NVDA minus AMD), dual-color area
#   3. Rolling 60-day correlation of daily returns
#   4. Scatter: NVDA daily returns vs AMD daily returns with trend line
#   5. Summary table: full-period return, annualized vol, correlation, beta
#
# NVDA = primary asset, AMD = reference (unified dashboard)
# =============================================================================

# --- Data ---
src = market_data_source(timeframe=1D)()
nvda_close = ffill(src.c)

amd_o, amd_h, amd_l, amd_c, amd_v, amd_vw, amd_n = reference_stocks(ticker='AMD')()
amd_close = ffill(amd_c)

# --- Daily returns ---
ret_nvda = returns(period=1)(nvda_close)
ret_amd = returns(period=1)(amd_close)

# --- Indexed cumulative returns (base 100) ---
# Cumulative product of (1 + daily return), then scale to 100
nvda_cum = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Product)(1.0 + ret_nvda) * 100.0
amd_cum = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Product)(1.0 + ret_amd) * 100.0

# --- Rolling 60-day returns for spread ---
nvda_60d = (nvda_close - (nvda_close >> 60)) / (nvda_close >> 60)
amd_60d = (amd_close - (amd_close >> 60)) / (amd_close >> 60)
spread_60d = nvda_60d - amd_60d

# Split for dual-color area fill
spread_pos = spread_60d if spread_60d > 0 else 0.0 / 0.0
spread_neg = spread_60d if spread_60d < 0 else 0.0 / 0.0

# --- Rolling 60-day correlation of daily returns ---
corr_60d = rolling_corr(window=60, method=CorrelationMethod.pearson)(x=ret_nvda, y=ret_amd)

# --- Full-period metrics for summary table ---
# Full-period annualized volatility (252-day window, use last value)
nvda_vol = volatility(period=252)(nvda_close)
amd_vol = volatility(period=252)(amd_close)

# Beta: NVDA returns vs AMD returns (expanding window via large window)
nvda_beta = beta(window=252)(asset_returns=ret_nvda, market_returns=ret_amd)

# Full-period correlation (expanding)
full_corr = rolling_corr(window=252, method=CorrelationMethod.pearson)(x=ret_nvda, y=ret_amd)

# Full-period cumulative return
nvda_total_ret = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Product)(1.0 + ret_nvda) - 1.0
amd_total_ret = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Product)(1.0 + ret_amd) - 1.0

# --- Timestamp for x-axis ---
bar_ts = index()

# =============================================================================
# REPORTS
# =============================================================================

# Chart 1: Indexed cumulative returns
xy_lines(
    title='NVDA vs AMD: Cumulative Returns (Base 100)',
    category='1. Price Action',
    y_axis_label='Indexed Return',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=0,
    log_scale=True,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='NVDA', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='AMD', color=Color.Sky)
    ]),
    order=1
)(bar_ts, nvda_cum, amd_cum)

# Chart 2: Rolling 60-day return spread with dual-color area fill
xy_lines(
    title='Rolling 60-Day Return Spread: NVDA Minus AMD',
    category='2. Relative Performance',
    area=True,
    y_axis_label='60-Day Return Spread',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Solid, title='0%')
    ]),
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='NVDA Outperforming', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='AMD Outperforming', color=Color.Slate)
    ]),
    order=2
)(bar_ts, spread_pos, spread_neg)

# Chart 3: Rolling 60-day correlation
xy_lines(
    title='Rolling 60-Day Correlation (Returns-Based)',
    category='3. Correlation',
    y_axis_label='Pearson Correlation',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ]),
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='60-Day Correlation', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    order=3
)(bar_ts, corr_60d)

# Chart 4: Scatter — NVDA daily returns vs AMD daily returns
xy_scatter(
    title='NVDA vs AMD Daily Returns',
    category='3. Correlation',
    x_axis_label='AMD Daily Return',
    x_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    x_axis_dp=1,
    y_axis_label='NVDA Daily Return',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    show_trend_line=True,
    series=ScatterSeriesSchema(series=[
        ScatterSeriesSpec(name='Daily Observations', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=4
)(x=ret_amd, y_values=ret_nvda)

# Summary table: key stats
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='NVDA vs AMD Summary Statistics',
        row_size=5,
        col_size=2,
        row_headers=['Total Return', 'Ann. Volatility', 'Correlation (252d)', 'Beta (NVDA vs AMD)', 'Correlation (60d)'],
        col_headers=['NVDA', 'AMD'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    ),
    category='4. Summary',
    order=5
)(nvda_total_ret, amd_total_ret, nvda_vol, amd_vol, full_corr, full_corr, nvda_beta, nvda_beta, corr_60d, corr_60d)
